description: Upgrade the DB engine version of a Cloud DB for MySQL instance

engineVersionCode.description: Target engine version code (e.g. 'MYSQL8.0.40'). Defaults to latest version if omitted.

isMajorVersionUpgrade.description: Major version upgrade (default: false). true: major upgrade (one step at a time, e.g. 5.7→8.0→8.4). false: minor upgrade only (e.g. 8.0.34→8.0.40).

name: ncloud_upgrade_mysql_version
